description: This Java source file defines the PhotoManager class, which manages background threads and caches for downloading and decoding images from the web, specifically optimized for an Android application. It handles thread pools, message passing to the UI thread, and image caching, coordinating tasks related to image download and processing.

classes.name: PhotoManager
classes.description: Manages background thread pools, image cache, and UI communication for downloading and decoding images in an Android app.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PhotoManager.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Handles state updates for a photo download/decode task, updating cache and communicating with the UI thread.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing download tasks by interrupting their threads.

methods.name: removeDownload
methods.description: Stops a specific download thread associated with a given task and URL.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Initiates download and decoding of an image for a given PhotoView, reusing cache if available.

methods.name: recycleTask
methods.description: Recycles a PhotoTask object for reuse, adding it back to the task pool.
